parsed.explanation: The Memoires de Rochester BIBL was never closed, so later book entries were nested inside it; a closing tag was added so each title is a sibling BIBL. The inconsistent PRICE tag was normalized to PRIZE. Corrupted character sequences were restored in context: groß, five 8vo. formats, Anfang, Gespräch, Würmern, and three price separators (–). List punctuation was moved out of three PRIZE elements, and the closing notice “und viele andere mehr…” was placed after the last BIBL, matching the untagged introductory sentence.
